knownLaterHead.note: main is 17 commits ahead; it contains DSH host volume/write access, shared stateDir bindings, and daemon handshake/benchmark/readme changes. It has no new Pi Pocket integration. This project stays on v1.0.0.

notes: Store calls run in the Node process. No Sandbox, Docker, or FUSE is needed for project/fs/branch.
The Store is the Disposable profile: no crash or power-loss durability.
project.init captures the whole source tree, ignored files included; this project stages only an explicit synthetic or owner-approved source path.
The public SDK has no layer listing. main is a line of Layers; commit history is per Branch.
README says LayerFS x Pi is planned. There is no official Pi Pocket adapter.
treeSha256Method: sha256 over sorted relative paths, type byte, size, and file bytes; symlinks by link target; root .git excluded

sdk.treeSha256Method: sha256 over sorted relative paths, type byte, size, file bytes, and link targets; native/ (Rust sources, not imported) excluded

nativeBuilds.note: Reviewed local release build of native/layerfs.node from the pinned v1.0.0 source tree; recorded in docs/NATIVE-E2E.md. Other toolchains must be recorded with setup --authorize-native after review.
